_readme: The Scout's watch config. Lanes are brands (keys match lib/constants.js BRANDS). Accounts are seeds: the worker drops handles that fail to resolve and adds creators whose posts score high on fit (see scout:watch:auto in Redis). Hashtags and searches are the discovery net. Budgets cap Apify spend per run.
